_note: jsdom has no layout, so getBoundingClientRect returns zeros: the Tier-0 builder's visible-post pick and its size-based photo/avatar filters cannot run, and capture falls back to the generic tagger path. This sidecar therefore asserts only that the right POST is reached; the built-card structure (avatar, byline, album grid, stats) is covered by facebook-feed-fixture-visual, which runs in a real browser.
